# Project fixtures

`published-v12-choice.capy` was written by `layer-core::Project::write` from
revision `4cbb0d41070aef63519889ae23f9f2e2095d3fb8`, with unchanged version-12
project code. Its SHA-256 is
`fdf4261d37d3c1d49717e9e3312e88b15d88b39b9e07a7c5d7f01182797eab5a`.

It contains a nonuniform 2×2 RGBA8 source, an embedded Curves effect with the
nondefault `Log HDR` domain, and literal Unicode names containing braces and
directional characters. `published_version_12_choices_and_pixels_resave_unchanged`
checks its original literal choice representation, names and source pixels,
then checks version-13 writes and explicit resource references.
